target_customer: Recreational adult tennis players who want organized local leagues and practice partners
problem: Casual players find it hard to find nearby opponents of similar level and to join organized competitive play without club membership.
business_model: Consumer mobile app, league fees (exact model not stated in sources opened)
product_category: Sports league and matchmaking mobile app

founders.name: Mat Vogels
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as the only founder and gives no bio. Bio fields are null because no source opened gave them.

technical_complexity.rationale: A league scheduling and matching app is standard mobile and backend work for a three person team; no hard technical problem is documented in sources.

defensibility.rationale: Local density of players could create a weak network effect, but league software and matching are easy to copy and no source shows lock in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The USTA ran its own league system through TennisLink (current app listing). No source shows whether it copied or bought the wedge.

market_need_then: Large base of recreational tennis players and an established league culture via the USTA, but no dated source opened quantified the unmet demand for informal local leagues.

brand_strength.rationale: Branding search found no press on logo, voice or community. Many unrelated apps share the Rally name, so the name was confusable.

outcome_analysis: Rally Tennis (legal entity Zestful per the YC URL slug and funding databases) raised a reported seed round in 2019 and is now marked Inactive by YC. No post-mortem, shutdown notice or acquisition report was found, so the cause of inactivity is not public and failure factors are left empty. The company site returned a 503 on fetch, which is consistent with but does not prove wind down.
notes: Both rounds rest on a single aggregator (StartupIntros) and CB Insights; CB Insights dates the seed 2019-07-29 and names Matchstick Ventures, StartupIntros dates it 2019-09-10 and names Thrive Capital as lead; CB Insights total is 8.22M over 10 rounds versus 6.1M on StartupIntros, so rounds are missing or differ. The YC page shows founding year 2021, which does not fit the W17 batch, so founded_year is null. Exit is unknown: the YC status is Inactive but no source states shutdown. No dated 2016 to 2017 competitor sources were found, list left empty; TennisLink is cited only as a current USTA listing. Company site rallytennis.com returned HTTP 503 on fetch. Interpretation: Rally Tennis and Zestful being one company rests on the YC URL slug and aggregator listings.
